_comment: Hand-curated mile-marker anchor overrides. Entries here take
precedence over the auto-anchor baked into each feature's
Key format: cls:num:lon:lat where lon/lat are the Natural Earth
feature's first vertex (AFTER the build tool's low-MM-end
normalization) rounded to 3 decimal places. Value is { mm: N }
where N is the real-world mile marker at that vertex.
Add entries here only when the auto-anchor gets a specific
route significantly wrong (e.g., route with spurs or alternates
that confuse the sort-by-distance-from-origin heuristic). For
typical end-to-end routes the auto-anchor is within ~2-5 mi of
real mile markers, which is well within Natural Earth's
